senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. תָּאַם) [to join, be joined,] to be whole, finished, perfect; to end, be gone.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:9">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> (ref. to <he>התמו</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 20:18">II Sam. XX, 18</cite>) <he>עד כאן תמו דברי תורה</he> are the words of the Lord so far gone (to be ignored)?; Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII <he>על כן תמו וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Shabbat 55a:13">Sabb. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>תַּמָּה זכות אבות</he> the protecting influence of the fathers has ceased.
<cite ref="Berakhot 57a:8">Ber. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>הרואה ת̇מ̇רים בחלום ת̇מ̇ו עונותיו</he> if one sees dates in his dream, his sins are ended (forgiven); a. fr.—
Cant. R. to V, 2 תַּמָּתִי תַּמּוֹתִי וכ׳ tammathi, read tammothi, I am complete, for they attached themselves &c., v. infra.

senses.gloss: to make perfect. Y. Yoma VII, end, 44ᶜ תומים שהן מְתִימִּין לפניהם וכ׳ they are called Tummim, because they perfect the way before them.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 32a:11">Ned. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>כל המַתְמִים עצמו שעה עומדת לו</he> if one perfects himself (tries to be perfect), time will stand by him (he will succeed in life, with ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 17:1">Gen. XVII, 1</cite>, a.

senses.gloss: (denom. of תָּמִים) to be upright, frank. Ib. כל המתמים עצמו הקב״ה מתמים עמו if one perfects himself (tries to be upright), God will deal uprightly with him (with ref. to II Sam. XXII, 26); Yalk. Sam. 161; a. e.
; Nithpa. נִתְתַּמֵּם (cmp. שָׁלַם) to be joined; to ally one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2">Ex. R. s. 2</cite> (ref. to <he>תמתי</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 5:2">Cant. V, 2</cite>) <he>שנִתְתַּמּוּ עמי בסיני</he> they attached themselves to me at Sinai and said (<cite ref="Exodus 24:7">Ex. XXIV, 7</cite>), all that &c.; Cant. R. l. c. (v. supra) <he>שנִתְמְמוּ</he> (or <he>שנִתַּמְּמוּ</he>); Pesik. Haḥod., p. 47ᵃ <he>שנִיתּמּוּ</he>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite> <he>שנותמו</he> (corr. acc.).
